$comment: The design-system adherence gate's one moving part — see
`pending` names the components that still carry the pre-restyle styling:
a hairline border, a soft radius, a colour that is nobody's token. They
are reported on every run and they do not fail the build, because the
restyle arrives screen by screen and a gate that fails on day one is a
gate somebody turns off on day two.
The list is only allowed to SHRINK. A file listed here that has no
violations left fails the build until it is removed, so the list cannot
outlive the work — which is the only thing that separates a waiver from
a hole. Adding a file is a deliberate act and a reviewable line in a
diff; there is no wildcard and there is no per-rule escape.
The list is empty: every component in this application draws its colour,
its font, its border, its radius and its shadow from tokens.css. The key
stays, and it stays empty, because the next component to be written is
the next one that could need waiving — and an empty list that somebody
has to add a name to is a reviewable line in a diff, which is the point.
